card.name: Just before the word drops
card.fires_on: Words and spaces right before an expected 'drops' or 'drop', such as 'a few' or 'two drops of' in instructions about liquids, eye drops, or sprays.

modes.label: Quantity before drops
modes.description: Small quantity words or 'of' in phrases about adding drops of a liquid.
